# Ollvy

> Ollvy is India's modern company registration and compliance platform. We help entrepreneurs register businesses, obtain necessary licenses, and stay compliant with Indian regulations - all online, with transparent pricing and real-time tracking.

## About

Ollvy simplifies business registration and compliance in India. Founded to make entrepreneurship accessible, we handle the paperwork so founders can focus on building. Our platform offers one-time registrations, recurring compliance filings, and expert guidance - all backed by practicing CAs and CS professionals.

- Website: https://www.ollvy.com
- Support: team@ollvy.com

## Services

### Company Registration
- [Private Limited Company Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/pvt-ltd-incorporation) - Register a Pvt Ltd with DSC, DIN, incorporation certificate
- [LLP Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/llp-incorporation) - Limited Liability Partnership with LLP Agreement
- [Company Name Change](https://www.ollvy.com/services/company-name-change) - Change your company's registered name with MCA

### Tax Registration
- [GST Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-registration) - Get your GSTIN in 3-7 days
- [GST Cancellation](https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-cancellation) - Voluntary GST cancellation
- [GST Revocation](https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-revocation) - Revoke cancelled GST registration

### Tax Filing
- [Business ITR Filing](https://www.ollvy.com/services/business-itr) - Company and LLP income tax returns
- [GST Monthly Filing](https://www.ollvy.com/services/gst-monthly) - GSTR-1, GSTR-3B monthly compliance
- [TDS Monthly Compliance](https://www.ollvy.com/services/tds-monthly-compliance) - TDS return filing and payment

### Company Compliance
- [MCA Annual Filing](https://www.ollvy.com/services/mca-annual-filing) - AOC-4, MGT-7 annual returns
- [DIN Reactivation](https://www.ollvy.com/services/din-reactivation) - Reactivate deactivated DIN

### Business Licenses & Other
- [MSME/Udyam Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/msme-registration) - MSME certificate for benefits
- [Trademark Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/trademark-registration) - Protect your brand name and logo
- [Cloud Kitchen Setup](https://www.ollvy.com/services/cloud-kitchen-setup) - Complete cloud kitchen compliance bundle
- [Business PAN Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/services/business-pan) - Company PAN in 7 working days
- [ESOP Structuring](https://www.ollvy.com/services/esop-structuring) - Complete ESOP scheme for your Pvt Ltd
- [IEPF Claim Consultation](https://www.ollvy.com/services/iepf-consultation) - IEPF database check for shares and dividends

Educational content to help founders understand Indian business compliance:

- [Is MSME Registration Worth It?](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/is-msme-registration-worth-it) - MSME benefits explained
- [DPIIT Startup Recognition](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/should-i-get-dpiit-startup-recognition) - Startup India benefits
- [PF Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/when-does-pf-registration-become-mandatory) - EPF compliance for employers
- [ESI Registration](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/when-does-esi-registration-become-mandatory) - ESIC compliance guide
- [Professional Tax](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/do-i-need-professional-tax-registration) - State-wise PT guide
- [FSSAI License Guide](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/do-i-need-fssai-license) - Food business licensing requirements

- [Shop & Establishment](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/do-i-need-shop-establishment-registration) - State-wise registration guide

### Income-tax Act 2025 Transition (effective 1 April 2026)
- [Old vs New Section Mapping](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/income-tax-act-2025-section-mapping) - 1961 Act to 2025 Act section finder (143(1) to 270(1), 148 to 280, 156 to 289)
- [New TDS Sections & Forms FY 2026-27](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/new-tds-sections-fy2026-27) - Sections 392/393/394 replace the 194 series; Forms 138/140/143/144 replace 24Q/26Q/27EQ/27Q
- [Form 141 for TDS on Property & Rent](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/form-141-tds-property-rent) - Replaces 26QB/26QC/26QD/26QE from FY 2026-27
- [Form 16 is Now Form 130](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/form-16-is-now-form-130) - New salary TDS certificate, issued by June 15, 2027

### Tax Filing Guides
- [Missed the ITR Deadline? Belated Return](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/belated-itr-2026) - Belated/revised return for AY 2026-27 by December 31, 2026
- [ITR-U Updated Return](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/itr-u-updated-return) - File up to 4 years back; AY 2022-23 window closes March 31, 2027
- [Salaried ITR 2027](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/salaried-itr-2027) - First ITR season under the new Act, due July 31, 2027
- [Business ITR 2027](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/business-itr-2027) - Non-audit business deadline moved to August 31, 2027

### Employer & Payroll Guides
- [Labour Codes Compliance](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/labour-codes-compliance-2026) - Four labour codes: 50% wages rule, appointment letters, CTC restructuring
- [EPF Scheme 2026](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/epf-scheme-2026) - New EPF Scheme effective July 1, 2026, replacing the 1952 scheme

### GST Guides
- [GST Invoice Management System (IMS)](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/gst-invoice-management-system-ims) - Mandatory accept/reject workflow, GSTR-3B ITC locking
- [GSTAT Appeal Guide](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/gstat-appeal-guide) - Appeal to the GST Appellate Tribunal, 10% pre-deposit
- [LUT Renewal FY 2027-28](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/lut-renewal-2027) - File before April 1, 2027 for zero-rated exports

### GST Notices
- [GST DRC-01 Notice](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/gst-drc-01-notice) - Tax demand response guide
- [GST REG-17 Cancellation](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/gst-reg-17-cancellation-notice) - Cancellation notice response

### Income Tax Notices
- [Section 143(1) Intimation](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/income-tax-143-1-intimation) - Processing intimation
- [Section 143(2) Scrutiny](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/income-tax-143-2-scrutiny) - Scrutiny assessment
- [Section 156 Demand](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/income-tax-156-demand) - Tax demand notice
- [Section 280/281 Reopening (new Act)](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/income-tax-280-281-reopening) - Reassessment notices under the Income-tax Act 2025, replacing 148/148A
- [Section 270(1) Intimation (new Act)](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/income-tax-270-intimation) - Replaces 143(1) for returns filed under the 2025 Act
- [Foreign Assets NUDGE SMS](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/schedule-fa-foreign-assets-notice) - Undisclosed foreign assets campaign; fix via revised return by December 31

## Compliance Deadlines

- [MCA Amnesty CCFS 2026](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/ccfs-2026) - Clear pending AOC-4/MGT-7/ADT-1 at 10% late fees, ends August 31, 2026
- [Tax Audit 2026](https://www.ollvy.com/tax-audit-2026) - Form 3CA/3CB/3CD due September 30, 2026
- [TDS Return Q2 FY2026-27](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/tds-return-q2-fy2026-27) - Due October 31, 2026
- [MGT-7 2026](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/mgt-7-2026) - Annual return due November 29, 2026
- [PAS-6 Reconciliation](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/pas-6-2026) - Half-year Apr-Sep 2026, due November 29, 2026
- [GSTR-9 FY 2025-26](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/gst-annual-2027) - GST annual return due December 31, 2026
- [FSSAI Annual Return D1](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/fssai-annual-return-2027) - FY 2026-27, due May 31, 2027 on FoSCoS
- [LLP Form 11 2027](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/llp-form-11-2027) - LLP annual return due May 30, 2027
- [Advance Tax Q1 FY 2027-28](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/advance-tax-q1-2027) - 15% due June 15, 2027
- [IEC Annual Update 2027](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/iec-annual-update-2027) - DGFT window April-June 2027; missing it deactivates the IEC
- [DPT-3 2027](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/dpt-3-2027) - Return of deposits due June 30, 2027
- [FLA Return 2027](https://www.ollvy.com/guides/fla-return-2027) - RBI foreign assets/liabilities return due July 15, 2027
